title: Coper Golem
description: The copper golem NEEDS to cope.
body:
### **NOTE: THE STATUES ARE NOT WORKING CURRENTLY**



But other than that, i think everything is okay. Here's the thing though i had to make the legs apart a bit, due to the copper golem being unsupported by optifine. I think everything should work (besides the statues.).

this is based on a meme by the way. i dont really know what the meme is though.
(also requires EMF and ETF)



EDIT: i think the copper golem is now supported by optifine, but i might not fix the pack until later.
